card.title: 2e ZOUAVES
card.text: Gets +2+2 if it is moved into the frontline.
card.flavorText: The 2nd Zouaves Regiment is an infantry unit of the French Army created in 1852 in Algiers, under the Second Empire. It was decorated multiple times for its actions during the Crimean Campaign and the First World War. In September 1939, it was stationed in Oran and was sent to Lebanon, where it was disbanded in November 1940. Following the Allied landing in North Africa in November 1942, the zouaves corps was re-formed and became mixed to compensate for the lack of manpower, recruiting Muslim North African soldiers. The 2nd Zouaves Regiment joined the 1st Armored Division upon its creation on May 1, 1943, then it was transformed into 3 independent motorized battalions. Embarked in half-tracks and operating in close coordination with the division's tanks, they took part in the Provence landings and the liberation of France, advancing from the Mediterranean to the Vosges mountains. The 1st Armored Division reached Alsace first, where it saw intense fighting during a harsh winter from November 1944 to February 1945. It then entered Germany and was first again to reach the Danube, where it ended the war. During this campaign, the zouaves suffered heavy losses, with 72% of their troops killed or wounded. The 2nd Zouaves Regiment was awarded the Croix de Guerre for its bravery.
